sloka: अगस्त्यस्त्वब्रवीद्रामं सर्वमेतछ्रुतं त्वया ।दृष्टः सम्भाषितश्चासि राम गच्छामहे वयम् ।। ७.३६.५३ ॥
transliteration: agastyastvabravīdrāmaṁ sarvametachrutaṁ tvayā ।dṛṣṭaḥ sambhāṣitaścāsi rāma gacchāmahe vayam ।। 7.36.53 ॥

translations.english: Agastya then said to Rama, "All this has been heard by you, O Rama; you have seen us and conversed with us, now we depart."
